content.title: Babel Scale Ascent | Human Anchor, Ramp Rise and City Reveal
content.summary: A surveyor's ramp leads from human scale to a colossal archive city. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One central axis persists throughout. + Human figures remain the scale reference. + Each reveal is larger than the previous one. + Architecture grows through continuous camera travel. + The final tower remains geographically connected.
quick_start.recommended_input: A tiny adult surveyor approaches one central ramp at the foot of a colossal sandstone archive. Pass two monumental seated librarians and six columns symmetrically without leaving the center axis. End on a distant, still larger stepped archive tower aligned with the ramp under a storm-bright sky.
required_anchors: Human figures remain the scale reference.
Architecture grows through continuous camera travel.
The final tower remains geographically connected.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.

applicable_scope: A surveyor's ramp leads from human scale to a colossal archive city. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

creative_dna.mechanism: 从荒地上一名极小行者和中央坡道建立人类尺度，镜头沿坡道持续上升，逐层显出工人、雕像、柱廊与施工结构；越过塔缘后再揭示远方更高主塔和广阔城市，形成连续尺度阶梯。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One central axis persists throughout."

invariants.rule: Each reveal is larger than the previous one.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Each reveal is larger than the previous one."

invariants.rule: Architecture grows through continuous camera travel.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Architecture grows through continuous camera travel."

invariants.rule: The final tower remains geographically connected.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final tower remains geographically connected."
